title: Masu Neman Gaskiya Masu Tawali'u
intro: A ƙasar da take cike da iko da sihiri na da, wani babban rikici ya ɓarke. Ɗaya daga cikin ɓangarorin yana amfani da ikon alamun allahntaka, yayin da ɗayan kuma ke ƙoƙarin daidaita abin da ba zai yiwu ba. Sakamakon zai canza tarihin har abada. Za ku iya gano asalin waɗanda suka shaida gaskiya ta ƙarshe kuma suka ƙasƙantar da kansu a gabanta?
clues: Mun shaida alamun da suka wuce dabarun sihiri
Duk mun faɗi cikin sujada, ba mu iya musanta gaskiya ba
Mun fahimci cewa waɗannan alamu sun fito ne daga Allah ɗaya na gaskiya
Mu ne al'umma ta farko da ta rungumi imani ta wannan hanya mai ban mamaki
An yi mana alƙawarin aljanna a matsayin sakamakon imaninmu
Igiyoyinmu da sandunanmu sun zama macizai a gaban idanunmu, duk da haka mun zaɓi biyayya

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Kalubalen da Rakumin Annabi Salih ya fuskanta
An aika babban ambaliyar ruwa a kan annabi
Tafiyar annabi a cikin kifin whale

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: Lalacewar da girgizar ƙasa ta yi kwatsam

arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَـٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verse: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses." (20:70)
